## This pull request is a continuation of https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/116205, and is similar to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/116199

- Closes: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/88226
- Closes: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/108184
- Closes: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/118498
- Closes: https://github.com/godotengine/godot-docs/issues/9794
- Supersedes: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/88314
- Supersedes: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/108389
- Supersedes: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/115174
- Supersedes: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/95877
- Addresses: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/115825 (property needs tooltip at least)
- Addresses: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/96194 (same as above)
- Addresses: [use Thread to improve audio generation performance](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/46490#issuecomment-787207578)
- Addresses: [player must be playing to record audio](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/69755#issuecomment-4061353193)
- Also see: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/93243
- - -
The intention of this pull request is to improve the class reference for every AudioStream class, including all player nodes, resources, and playbacks. My approach towards this goal is to improve descriptions towards clarity and consistency, and provide useful technical notes. There were also some incorrect information that this PR fixes.

My source for these changes comes mostly from my understanding of the source code, and testing, but some information was left alone, or barely edited.

**All feedback is welcomed**, especially technical ones (how some methods/properties behave).
- - -
### Here's a highlight list of changes applied to multiple files:
- Explicitly mention in which cases methods can return an "unexpected" value, and what those values are
- Add tips
- Add use cases for games
- Add more relevant tutorials
- Suggest best audio formats for each use

### Here's a highlight list of changes for specific files:
- `AudioStreamPlayback`: fix mentions of how the engine uses some methods, fix explanation for monophonic, complete cases for `get_length()`
- Audio stream players: replace mute "method" for a better one, mention how some streams can hold multiple sub-streams
- `AudioStreamPlayer2D`: add unit to `max_distance`
- `AudioStreamPlayer3D`: fix wrong filter mentioned
- `AudioStreamMP3`: disincentivize user from using MP3 for beat-sync features

I might've missed some other highlights - these also don't include changes suggested by the linked pages/comments above
- - -
### Things I'm unsure of:
- Game usage examples for `AudioStreamGenerator`, `AudioStreamMicrophone`, `AudioStreamPolyphonic`, and `AudioStreamSynchronized` (none were added)
- Complexity: while I'm happy with the amount of technical details added (it also didn't look like much to me in the editor), I understand wanting to keep things simple. So if the changes really are too much, I'd like to know how things could be simplified without removing important detail. Audio can be frustrating to work with, especially for being such an invisible thing.
